reviews.title: Nice upgrade for half the cost!
reviews.comment: Coming from an AMD Radeon VII, specs on paper are double that from my previous card, only complaint I have is, I HAVE to use windows to get fan control working. So far it’s a great card to use. Edit - I am having an absolute BLAST with this purchase, drivers work right out of the installer, my ONLY critique I have isn’t because of the card, but because of intel - the fan controller used on this card, will make it tough to stay on Linux, I had to switch to windows to even have access to fan speed on the card. Unless I have to do a fresh install of my Linux distribution of choice, I couldn’t get fan speed control at all. Like I said in the edit, I’m having a blast with this card despite the one small inconvenience.
reviews.author: Nextarkid122

reviews.title: Great at what it's designed for
reviews.comment: It's exactly as described. Shipping was fast, arrived first day Amazon said in the timetable. Works well so far with gaming, no studdering or any issues with fps games or rpgs. It obviously doesn't have ray tracing or that but it wasn't designed that way. I will admit I was a little worried that it doesn't ship stateside but the shipping and customs was very quick. I've had other items get held up in customs before. Was well packaged in original box with celephane on it. Then wrapped in 3 layers of the small bubble wrap. So if you enjoy popping those you'll get the added bonus of having lots to pop!
reviews.author: David Sheller

reviews.title: Good specs and no issues (so far)
reviews.comment: So far so good. I can’t complain about it. Considering it’s a fresh platform, it’s been doing what it’s supposed to do. Maybe not for high end gaming on 4K but 1080P on high settings is definitely doable.
reviews.author: KV

reviews.title: It's a huge risk but worth it.
reviews.comment: I'm happy with it. This GPU provides future proofing with 16GB of VRAM. It seems to perform well on most mainstream games. I was afraid of this GPU because it is a huge risk due to the fact that Intel is rather new to GPU drivers AND the manufacturer is chinese. However it seems to work well and I'm just happy that there is any competition at all.
reviews.author: Israel
